read.thesis: Deere's order bank up over 50% in the quarter to its highest since May 2024, with North American large tractor inventory cut and used 8R inventory down over 40%, pointing to 2026 as the cycle bottom.

triggers.label: Order bank up over 50% QoQ
triggers.quote: our order bank has risen by over 50% in the past quarter, reaching its highest point since May of 2024
triggers.highlight: order bank has risen by over 50%

triggers.label: MY22-23 8R used down 40%+
triggers.quote: model year '22 and model year '23 8R tractors are down more than 40% in that same time period

triggers.label: SAT new field inventory ~40% lower YoY
triggers.quote: current new field inventory for both tractor horsepower categories in this segment, that's the less than 100-horsepower category and the 100 to 220-horsepower category are each about 40% lower year-over-year

triggers.label: C&F price realization just under -0.5pt
triggers.quote: Price realization was negative by just under 0.5 point.

triggers.label: SAT margin guide raised to 13.5-15%
triggers.quote: The segment's operating margin guide is now between 13.5% and 15%.

guidance.quote: our updated outlook for net income is now between $4.5 billion and $5 billion
We now expect net sales to be up about 15%.
The segment's operating margin guide is now between 13.5% and 15%.
is now estimated to be between 9% and 11%.
2026 net sales are now forecasted to be up around 15%.
our full year forecast remains between 11% and 13%.
net sales are still forecasted to be down between 5% and 10% for the full year.
Tariffs for the year are still projected at around $1.2 billion
is now expected to be between $4.5 billion and $5.5 billion
we continue to expect the large ag equipment industry in the U.S. and Canada to decline 15% to 20% this year

red_flags.label: Tariff burden ~$1.2B; price/cost only neutral
red_flags.quote: We're probably closer now to price/cost neutral for the full year

red_flags.label: Share ceded in NA large ag last 12-18 months
red_flags.quote: over the last 12 to 18 months, we've ceded a little bit of share

evasions.topic: Order book vs corn prices / large ag guide unchanged
evasions.quote: I mean, as you're right, I think from an ag fundamental standpoint, still challenged and haven't seen a whole lot of change there
